findings.title: Account 3 is seeded as never activated but has a paid invoice
findings.why_it_matters: README.md says account 3 never had service delivered, so nothing may have been billed or paid. The row is referentially valid and dated after the account, so scenario-integrity passes, yet the two tables assert opposite facts and every test built on scenario 3 tests a state that cannot exist.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove invoice 301, or add a check that an account in never_activated has no paid invoice.
